description: This file defines a Java class 'PromoServices' which provides several static methods related to promo code management within the OFBiz framework. The methods include creating promo code sets, purging old store promos, importing promo codes from files, and importing promo code emails. It interacts heavily with OFBiz entity engine, services, and utilizes utility classes for various operations.

classes.name: PromoServices
classes.description: A utility class providing static methods for managing promotion-related services in the OFBiz framework.

methods.name: createProductPromoCodeSet
methods.description: Generates a set of unique promo codes based on specified layout and length, creating promo code entities and returning the list.

methods.name: purgeOldStoreAutoPromos
methods.description: Removes expired promotion applications associated with a specific product store, based on the current timestamp.

methods.name: importPromoCodesFromFile
methods.description: Reads a file of promo codes, validates, and creates promo code entities for each valid code.

methods.name: importPromoCodeEmailsFromFile
methods.description: Imports email addresses from an uploaded file and associates them with a promo code, creating contact mechanisms if necessary.
